rows.text: The Cabinet Secretariat memorandum dated 9 June 2024 states that Shri Narendra Modi has been sworn in as the Prime Minister by the President at 1915 hours that day in Rashtrapati Bhavan, and that the listed ministers were sworn in at the same time.
